title: China, Pak propose peace plan for West Asia, call for 'immediate' end to hostilities
description: BEIJING, Apr 1 : China and Pakistan have put forward a five-point proposal to end the West Asia conflict, calling for the restoration of peace and stability in the Gulf region and safe passage of ships through the Strait of Hormuz. The peace proposal was put forward on Tuesday after Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi held talks with Pakistan’s Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar, who undertook a one-day visit to Beijing to discuss regional developments. title: French navy chief says China will have to engage more in Strait of Hormuz discussion
description: PARIS, April 1 (Reuters) - China will at one point have to engage more directly on how to restore oil traffic flows in the Strait of Hormuz because the number of vessels it has going through is probably insufficient, France's navy chief said on Wednesday.

title: China's Role in Unblocking the Strait of Hormuz
description: France's navy chief emphasizes China's need for more direct involvement in restoring oil traffic at the Strait of Hormuz.
